description: This file defines a React functional component named SidebarFilters that renders a sidebar UI for filtering items based on search text, visibility of missing or obsolete items, and severity level. It manages user interaction through input fields and checkboxes, updating filters via a callback.

methods.name: SidebarFilters
methods.description: React component rendering filtering controls panel with search input, checkboxes for 'show missing' and 'show obsolete', and a severity dropdown.
